blueprints.description: People, the org chart, time off and onboarding for an HR team: a directory of cards, employee pages, an org tree, time-off requests and balances, and onboarding checklists.

screens.name: hr.directory
screens.title: Directory
screens.description: Everyone in the company as cards with their photo, title, department and contact.

screens.name: hr.directory.record
screens.title: Employee
screens.description: One employee: personal and job information, documents and time-off balance.

screens.name: hr.org
screens.title: Org chart
screens.description: Who reports to whom, as a tree.

screens.name: hr.timeoff
screens.title: Time off
screens.description: Time-off requests to approve, with who is away and for how long.

screens.name: hr.timeoff.balances
screens.title: Balances
screens.description: What each employee has taken and has left.

screens.name: hr.onboarding
screens.title: Onboarding
screens.description: New hires and how far along their onboarding is.

screens.name: hr.onboarding.record
screens.title: Onboarding checklist
screens.description: One new hire's checklist: sections of tasks, each with an owner and a due date.

templates.name: HrEmployeeDirectory
templates.description: Employees as cards with photo, name, title, department and contact, filtered by department, location and status.

templates.name: HrEmployeePage
templates.description: One employee: personal and job information, documents and time-off balance.

templates.name: HrOrgChart
templates.description: The company as a tree of who reports to whom, with titles and report counts.

templates.name: HrTimeOffList
templates.description: Time-off requests with the employee, type, dates, days and status, filtered by type, status and period.

templates.name: HrTimeOffBalanceList
templates.description: Each employee's entitlement, days taken and days left, with how much of it is used.

templates.name: HrOnboardingList
templates.description: New hires with their start date, owner and a progress bar of their checklist.

templates.name: HrOnboardingChecklist
templates.description: One new hire's onboarding: checklist sections with an owner and a due date for each task, and the key facts of the hire.

templates.name: HrRequestTimeOff
templates.description: A short form that asks for time off without leaving the page.

templates.name: HrQuickCreateEmployee
templates.description: A short form that creates one employee without leaving the page.
